narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One half, one fourth, one eighth and one eighth make one.
<bookmark mark='same'/>They do add up to one, but one eighth is used twice.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Every unit in the sum must be a different fractional unit.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>To find more sums, split one unit into two different smaller units.
